Name: Stardew Valley Splash Screens for Mod Organizer 2
Author: ClockworkAngels
Description:
[i][center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/YYymOGC.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[/i]This is a replacement for the Mod Organizer 2 splash screen that appears when you open the application. I don't know if many other people use Mod Organizer 2 to mod Stardew Valley, but I thought we could use some custom splash screens nonetheless, for the few including myself who would use them. They're simple but cute. They use edited official assets by ConcernedApe and from the [url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/]Stardew Scroll Generator[/url].

[center]﻿~*~[/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/H4XNiJv.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]The way that you install it depends on which kind of MO2 installation you have.

[u]For a global installation:[/u]
Pick one file to use. Place "Splash.png" in MO2's instance folder for Stardew Valley. It is located at this file path:
C:\Users\[Your PC Account Name]\AppData\Local\ModOrganizer\[Game Name]
You can also open the instance folder in MO2 (click on the folder icon in the toolbar, then click on "Open Instance folder").

[u]For a portable installation:[/u]
Pick one file to use. Place "Splash.png" in MO2's installation folder. This depends on where you chose to install it. You can open the installation folder from MO2 (click on the folder icon in the toolbar, then click "Open MO2 Install Folder").
